title: Ax-Schanuel for the Drinfeld $j$-function
summary: We prove an analog of the Ax-Schanuel theorem for the Drinfeld $j$-function in odd characteristic. Roughly speaking, if the graph of $\boldsymbol{j}\colonΩ^n\rightarrow\mathbb{A}^n_{\mathbb{C}_\infty}$ and its derivatives has an atypical intersection $\mathcal{V}$ with an algebraic variety, then $\mathcal{V}$ projects to a weakly-special subvariety in $\mathbb{A}^n_{\mathbb{C}_\infty}$. More generally, we prove a positive characteristic analog of the differential Galois theoretic Ax-Schanuel theorem of Blázquez-Sanz, Casale, Freitag and Nagloo.
